capabilities: Imports single videos with auto-detected chapters
Converts playlists into numbered course folders
Fetches chapters for the open video note
Tracks lesson progress with a live progress bar
extras: No API keys, backend servers, or external binaries; requests go only to youtube.com on explicit import; no analytics or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn YouTube videos or playlists into structured notes with chapters, clickable timestamps, and course progress tracking.

relations.evidence: makes requests only to youtube.com when you explicitly trigger an import

summary: YouTube importer that turns videos and playlists into chapter-based notes and course folders with clickable timestamps and progress tracking.
